descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Enter a haunted battleground of chaos in Paranormal Mayhem,
a 3v1 multiplayer VR experience where three interdimensional explorers invade eerie mansions, searching for hidden crystals—while one player becomes the Overlord, a vengeful demon determined to stop them. Armed with guns, the team must work together to locate the crystal and escape before the Overlord’s zombies overwhelm them.

As the overlord, you control the chaos—locking doors, summoning zombie hordes, and setting up ambushes to terrorize the intruders. But once they grab the crystal, your powers surge, and the final chase begins. Will you outsmart the Overlord and escape, or will the haunted house become your grave?

Join our Discord server in order to connect and play with others!
https://discord.gg/4DqaSPcSM9
